og.description:
Founded in 2017 as an inter-dimensional, ever-evolving cultural platform, the organization engages in diverse sonic + cultural programming, plant-based food + beverage, alongside experimental design and ecological explorations. The campus itself — located in the historic ASPCA headquarters in Gowanus, Brooklyn — now spans five spaces: a restaurant and music venue \[The Atrium\], a sonically-immersive live and club venue \[Sound Room\], an all-day cafe \[Cafe Public\], an intimate listening lounge and cocktail bar \[UPSTAIRS\], and an open-air plant nursery x event space \[The Nursery\].

The Sound Room features an entirely custom-built sound system from the collaboration of Devon Turnbull of OJAS and Jason Ojeda, a custom-built Isonoe rotary mixer, and lighting designed and built by Brooklyn-based Nitemind. Carefully-curated programming brings a varied range of live acts, DJs, and producers into the intimate space.
